question: Who discovered blood groups?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karl Landsteiner.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Karl Landsteiner discovered the **ABO blood group** system in **1901**, which categorized blood into four main types: A, B, AB, and O.
 
• His discovery was crucial for **safe blood transfusions**, preventing adverse reactions due to incompatible blood types.
 
• Landsteiner was awarded the **Nobel Prize** in Physiology or Medicine in 1930 for his work on blood groups.
 
• Blood is composed of plasma (55%) and formed elements (45%), which include red blood cells **(RBCs**), white blood cells (**WBCs**), and **platelets**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Isaac Newton:**

 
 
• He is Known for the law of **universal gravitation**, which explains the attraction between masses, crucial for physics.
 
• His work laid the groundwork for classical mechanics, influencing many scientific fields.
 
 
 
• **Dmitri Mendeleev:**
 
 
• He Developed the **Periodic Table of Elements**, which organizes elements by atomic number and properties, essential for chemistry studies.
 
• Predicted the existence of undiscovered elements based on his table, demonstrating the importance of systematic classification in science.
 
 
 
• **Alexander Fleming:**
 
 
• He Discovered **penicillin**, the first true antibiotic, which transformed medical treatment and reduced mortality from bacterial infections.
 
• His work led to the development of other **antibiotics**, playing a vital role in **modern medicine**.
